people.name: Gibbethon
people.line: A Levitical city in the territory of Dan.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Omri
people.line: King of Israel; father of Ahab

people.name: Tirzah
people.line: Canaanite city that became the capital of Israel

translations.web: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
translations.bsb: Then Omri and all the Israelites marched up from Gibbethon and besieged Tirzah.
